data.title: "Siam Music Yamaha Empowers 'Nene Royal' and 'OZONE' band
data.description: Siam Music Yamaha Co., Ltd, Thailand’s leading music business and pioneer music education institution, continues its vital mission to inspire and foster the potential of Thai youth. The company recently announced major support for "Nene Royal" or "Praew-Rattikarn Aumloy," following her monumental achievement in winning a world-class reality talent competition in the United States, along with the members of the youth music band "OZONE," who have played a significant role in inspiring Thai youths to pursue music.

data.title: Man City scandal could taint Premier League brand
data.description: MANCHESTER, England - The Premier League has won a lengthy legal battle with Manchester City over financial impropriety, but the consequences could leave lasting damage for a league that has long since become the envy of world football.

data.title: Afghanistan says deadly Pakistani strikes hit Helmand
data.description: KABUL — The Pakistani military launched rare deadly strikes on Afghanistan's Helmand province on Thursday, the Taliban government and residents told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ).

data.title: Kremlin critic, chess legend Kasparov says US intelligence warned life 'in danger'
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Kremlin critic and chess legend Garry Kasparov said Thursday that US and Lithuanian security services had told him and his ally that their lives were in danger and urged them to take security precautions.

data.title: Indian pilot hailed as ‘hero’ after cockpit struggle
data.description: MUMBAI — Indian pilot Smit Machchhar was hailed as a "hero" on Thursday after fighting to retain control of a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight when his co-pilot attacked him, leaving him wounded but helping avert disaster.

data.title: Plastic treaty talks chair sees deal possible in March
data.description: Countries negotiating a world-first treaty to limit plastic pollution are less divided than before and a deal could be agreed in March, the diplomat chairing the talks told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) on Thursday.

data.title: PM revokes Thai citizenship of Israeli businessman
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has signed an order revoking the Thai citizenship of an Israeli-born man for failing to disclose and renounce other nationalities upon naturalisation.

data.title: TCMA and FTI advance Thailand’s industrial transformation
data.description: The Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) and the Federation of Thai Industries (FTI) are advancing their strategic collaboration by positioning Saraburi Sandbox as a real-world platform for industrial transformation, bringing together government, the private sector and civil society to translate practical experience into broader industrial action, strengthen competitiveness and support Thailand’s transition toward a low-carbon economy and Net Zero 2050.

data.title: Northern water runoff the next challenge
data.description: There will be no heavy rain in the Central Plains, including Bangkok and surrounding provinces, over the next 10 days, but communities in the Chao Phraya basin should prepare for a water runoff influx from northern Thailand, says natural disaster specialist Seree Supratid.

data.title: Phu Kradueng reopens after seasonal closure
data.description: Phu Kradueng National Park has reopened after four-month seasonal closure and is ready to serve up to 3,500 visitors per day, with enhanced security measures.

data.title: Large crocodile killed for safety in flooded Chachoengsao
data.description: CHACHOENGSAO - A large crocodile spotted near a residential area during flooding in Sanam Chai Khet district has been put down by authorities after it was deemed a threat to local residents.

data.title: US woman survives lethal-drug execution attempt
data.description: Christa Pike, convicted of murdering a schoolmate three decades ago, survived an attempt to execute her by means of lethal injection late on Wednesday, foiling the first attempt to put a woman to death in Tennessee for two centuries.

data.title: New movies out this week: Oct 1-7
data.description: Six new releases that hit cinemas in Thailand this week.

data.title: Another Lao activist disappears in Thailand
data.description: A Lao content creator and activist based in Thailand has not been seen in nearly two weeks and concerns are growing that he may have been abducted or taken back to Laos, a Thailand-based human rights organisation says.

data.title: New accommodation law proposed to replace Hotel Act
data.description: The government has proposed replacing the Hotel Act with a new law designed to bring more accommodation businesses into the regulatory system.

data.title: ONE Championship: Lee Seung Cheol bout off over Karen Ghazaryan’s visa delays
data.description: South Korea’s Lee Seung Cheol has had his push towards a ONE Championship strawweight MMA title shot interrupted, with his bout against Karen Ghazaryan pulled from this weekend’s ONE Fight Night 48 card.

data.title: Bangkok road flooding update
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration reported flooding remained on several roads with levels ranging from 5 to 40 centimetres in some northern and eastern areas on Thursday morning.

data.title: Japan tightens permanent residency rules for foreigners
data.description: TOKYO - Japan has toughened requirements for foreigners wanting to obtain permanent residency, as part of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s push to tighten immigration controls.

data.title: Dozens wounded as French school protests escalate
data.description: PARIS - French security forces on Wednesday detained over 600 people while dozens of police and gendarmes were wounded as protests that have seen blockades of high schools and violent clashes escalated, the interior minister said.

data.title: EU seeking better ways to manage deportations
data.description: BRUSSELS - The European Union will discuss further ways to boost migrant deportations on Thursday, as a group of nations forges ahead with divisive plans to send failed asylum-seekers to return centres outside the bloc.

data.title: ONE Championship reunites with Venum for apparel and competition glove deal
data.description: ONE Championship has reunited with Venum through an apparel and glove deal, marking a striking about-turn in its relationship with the French fightwear brand.
